insight.headline: Order Update Taxes
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated for an unfulfilled order. This change ensures accurate tax calculations based on the new shipping destination. The update applies to API version 2026-10 and later.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their order update logic to account for the new tax recalculation behavior. This change may affect existing order management workflows, so thorough testing is recommended. Additionally, developers should review their tax calculation logic to ensure it aligns with the updated behavior. The orderUpdate mutation now returns the updated tax information, which can be used to update the order totals and display the correct tax amounts to customers.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see more accurate tax calculations when updating shipping addresses for unfulfilled orders, ensuring compliance with tax regulations and reducing potential errors.
insight.why_it_matters: Accurate tax calculations are crucial for merchants to comply with tax regulations and avoid potential penalties. This update ensures that Shopify's tax calculations are up-to-date and reflect the latest changes in tax laws and regulations.

updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, allowing for more flexible and dynamic cart management.

updates.title: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
updates.summary: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is being moved from reserved to committed, changing how in-progress inventory holds are represented.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, enabling AI agents to interact with online stores.

updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing developers to deploy Hydrogen storefronts to Oxygen from dev stores.

updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, enhancing order management capabilities.

updates.summary: Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have been updated to better reflect real-world fulfillment operations.

updates.title: Hydrogen developer preview update: July 30, 2026
updates.summary: The Hydrogen developer preview has been updated with new capabilities, including Vue bindings, to extend the ways developers can build Shopify storefronts.

updates.title: New fields for cash management activities and drawers in POS
updates.summary: New fields are available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities.

updates.summary: Merchants can now see partner details on collaborator requests, providing more context for decision-making.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance campaign insights, UI extensions, and storefront events

themes.title: ShopifyQL and Campaign Insights
themes.detail: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query data on behalf of authorized merchants. The shop_campaign_insights schema is now available in ShopifyQL. This update enables more informed decision-making for merchants.

themes.title: UI Extensions and Development Tools
themes.detail: The Shopify CLI has been updated to version 4.6.1, which includes serving UI extension source maps during app development. This update improves the development experience for building UI extensions.

themes.title: Storefront Events and Cart Attributes
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, with the updateCart standard action updating cart attributes and a new shopify:cart:attributes-update event firing when an attributes update is initiated. This update streamlines cart management and attribute updates.
